nodes.name: New Lead Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. Receives POST submissions from the website lead form. Expected JSON body fields: 'Full Name', 'Email', 'Phone', 'Company', 'Service Required', 'Budget', 'Message'.

nodes.name: Validate & Clean Lead Data
nodes.notes: Trims/normalizes every incoming field, lower-cases + regex-checks the email, flags any missing required field, and generates a unique Lead ID (LEAD-<timestamp>-<random>). Outputs isValid + missingFields for the IF node below.

nodes.name: Is Lead Valid?
nodes.notes: Routes valid leads into the AI qualification pipeline; incomplete submissions are rejected immediately with a 400 response instead of wasting an AI call.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, leadId: $json.leadId, error: 'Missing or invalid required fields', missingFields: $json.missingFields } }}

nodes.name: Respond - Invalid Lead
nodes.notes: Sends a 400 response back to the form so the front end can show the visitor which fields still need to be filled in.

nodes.name: AI Lead Analysis
nodes.notes: Sends the lead's message + context to an LLM and asks for a structured JSON verdict: category, intent, leadQuality (Hot/Warm/Cold), priority (1-10), summary, recommendedAction. Can be swapped for n8n's native OpenAI/Anthropic chat node - keep 'JSON only' instruction either way.

nodes.name: Parse & Merge AI Analysis
nodes.notes: Parses the LLM's JSON reply, validates leadQuality/priority against safe ranges, and merges the AI fields back onto the original cleaned lead record. If parsing fails for any reason, it falls back to a safe 'Warm / needs manual review' verdict instead of breaking the workflow.

nodes.name: Store Lead in Sheets
nodes.notes: Appends one row per lead to the 'Leads' tab with all 16 required columns (original data + AI-generated fields). If this node throws (e.g. API quota, auth expired), the whole workflow execution fails and is caught by the 'Workflow Error Trigger' branch at the bottom of the canvas.

nodes.name: Route by Lead Quality
nodes.notes: Sends each lead down exactly one of three branches based on the AI-assigned leadQuality: output 0 = Hot, output 1 = Warm (also the fallback/default), output 2 = Cold. NOTE: rebuild the routing rules in the n8n UI Switch editor (Hot / Warm / Cold string-equals rules) after import - the visual rule builder does not round-trip cleanly through raw JSON.

nodes.name: Notify Sales Team
nodes.notes: All three quality branches (Hot/Warm/Cold) converge here - only one branch actually fires per lead, but all three connect into this single node. Swap for a Slack node if the sales team prefers Slack over email.

nodes.name: Calculate Follow-up Date
nodes.notes: Computes the follow-up due date: Hot = +1 day, Warm = +3 days, Cold = +7 days.

nodes.name: Create Follow-up Task
nodes.notes: Writes a reminder row to the 'Follow-ups' tab. Pair this sheet with an n8n Schedule Trigger workflow (e.g. runs daily) that reads rows where Follow-up Date <= today AND Follow-up Status = 'Pending' and alerts the rep.

nodes.name: Log Execution - Success
nodes.notes: Appends a row to the 'Logs' tab: Lead ID, Timestamp, Status=Success, no error. This is the execution/log record requested in requirement 9.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, leadId: $json.leadId, message: 'Thanks! Your request has been received.' } }}

nodes.name: Respond - Success
nodes.notes: Final response sent back to whatever submitted the original webhook (website form, CRM, etc.) confirming the lead was processed.

nodes.name: Workflow Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires automatically whenever ANY node above throws an unhandled error (e.g. Google Sheets auth expired, SMTP timeout, AI API down) and the workflow execution fails. This is the standard n8n pattern for requirement 8 (catch -> record -> notify admin) without cluttering every node with manual error branches. Set this workflow as the 'Error Workflow' in this workflow's Settings so real failures reach it.

nodes.name: Format Error Log Data
nodes.notes: Extracts the failed node name and error message from the Error Trigger's payload. The original Lead ID isn't automatically available to a separate error workflow execution - for exact Lead ID correlation, also wrap the critical nodes' 'Settings > On Error' as 'Continue (using error output)' and log the leadId there directly instead of relying solely on this branch.

nodes.name: Log Execution - Error
nodes.notes: Records the failure in the same 'Logs' tab used for successes, so the team has one place to audit every execution.

nodes.name: Notify Admin - Error
nodes.notes: Immediately alerts the admin/ops team by email whenever Google Sheets or email sending fails (or any other node errors out), satisfying requirement 8.
